blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Brazilian Portuguese remains underserved by open-source language models, and the few that are safety-aligned rarely document what did not work or validate comparisons with statistical significance. We present Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, the second-generation post-training alignment of Manacá-1B (1.72B parameters, trained from scratch for PT-BR), with an SFT corpus of 291,223 examples. We document three DPO attempts, all negative, including a case where the training reward margin reaches 1.0 while free generation does not change at all, and show that safety came from a dedicated safety-SFT (LLM-jp AnswerCarefully style), refined over three iterations until closing the safety-helpfulness frontier. A controlled scan of the fraction of general data in the safety-SFT mix (10% to 60%) reveals a non-monotonic over-refusal curve with a knee point at 40-50%. The final model is compared against four external PT-BR models on the same items, with Wilson confidence intervals and paired McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction: the lower bound of its safety interval (94.1%) lies above the upper bound of all four baselines. We also report a methodological finding for LLM-judge evaluation: on two of six safety items in MT-Bench-PT, the judge categorically refuses to assign a score regardless of the evaluated response, silently reducing the effective N of that category in every prior report of the project. We complement this with an n-gram decontamination check and a Chinchilla-anchored compute-budget table that attributes the gap in general capability to pre-training scale rather than alignment methodology. All code, raw data, logs, and scripts that produce every reported number are publicly released.
blocks.zh: 巴西葡萄牙语仍然得不到开放源码语言模型的服务,少数安全对应语言很少记录哪些不可行或与统计重要性的比较。 我们提出Manacá-1B-Instruct-2,这是Manacá-1B(1.72B参数,从零开始为PT-BR培训)的第二代培训后调整,其中的SFT包有291 223个实例。 我们记录了三次DPO尝试,都是负面的,包括培训奖励幅度达到1.0,而自由一代却丝毫不改变的情况,并表明安全来自一种专用的安全-SFT(LLM-jp AnswerCacultly style),经过精细的三次迭代,直到关闭安全-帮助前沿。 对安全-SFT组合中一般数据(10%至60%)的分量进行控制扫描后,可发现一个膝盖点为40-50%的非运动过度反射曲线。 最终的型号与相同物品上的4个外部PT-BR型号相比,具有威尔逊置信间隔,并与Holm-Bonferroni校正为麦克内马尔测试配对:其安全间隔的下限(94.1%)位于所有4个基线的上限之上. 我们还报告LLM法官评价的方法调查结果:在MT-Bench-PT的6个安全项目中,法官断然拒绝分配一个分数,而不管评估的答复如何,在该项目的每份前一份报告中,都默默减少该类别的有效N。 我们用n克消毒检查和Chinchilla-Anchored计算预算表来补充这一点,这些预算表将一般能力的差距归结为培训前规模,而不是调整方法。 所有代码,原始数据,日志,以及产生每个报告数字的脚本都公开发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Open language models for Brazilian Portuguese have grown in number, but the
safety alignment of these models is rarely documented with the same rigor as
pre-training: negative results tend to be left out, small N N for safety
probes rules out any significance test, and evaluation by an LLM judge is
treated as a black box trusted by construction. Manacá-1B-Instruct [ 1 ] (first generation) had already adopted LLM-jp’s AnswerCarefully method [ 2 ] to align safety via dedicated SFT,
after on-policy DPO failed to reverse the model’s compliance with harmful
requests, but with probes of 16/34 items, insufficient for any paired test.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
This work builds on three lines of research. The first is the development of
open LLMs native to Portuguese: Manacá-1B-Instruct itself, first generation [ 1 ] , whose evolution this report documents; the Tucano
family [ 3 , 4 ] , which includes both models trained from scratch
in Portuguese (Tucano-1b1, Tucano-2b4) and a continual-pretraining model on
Qwen3 (Tucano2-qwen); and TeenyTinyLlama [ 5 ] . All four are used as
external baselines in Section 4.4 . The safety-alignment method
followed here, dedicated SFT in AnswerCarefully style, comes from the
LLM-jp project [ 2 ] , an open-LLM initiative for Japanese whose
evaluation practice also informs the design of this report.

blocks.en:
The third is the reliability of LLM judges, relevant to the finding in
Section 4.5 . The founding MT-Bench paper [ 7 ] characterizes positional bias, verbosity bias, self-enhancement bias, and
limited reasoning/mathematical ability as the known flaws of the judge-LLM
paradigm. More recent work addresses adjacent problems: Eiras et al. [ 8 ] show that safety judges are fragile to changes in the
style of the evaluated response and to adversarial attacks that trick them
into classifying harmful content as safe; Pasch [ 9 ] documents that LLM judges score ethics-motivated candidate refusals more
favorably than human evaluators ( moderation bias ); Vishnubhotla et al. [ 10 ] document high disagreement across different safety
judges, varying by criterion and harm category; and Zhang [ 11 ] , using Claude Sonnet 4-6 as the sole judge over 400
HarmBench behaviors, shows that the judge’s prompt choice shifts the measured
harmful-response rate by up to 24.2 percentage points. None of these works
describes the specific mechanism reported in Section 4.5 : the
judge itself triggering its API-level safety layer
( stop_reason=refusal , officially documented as a normal HTTP 200
response, not an error [ 12 ] ) when instructed to score a
response to a sensitive prompt, silently removing the item from the
denominator instead of producing a score.

blocks.en: 3.1 Model and Instruction Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.1 型号和指令公司

blocks.en:
Manacá-1B-Instruct-2 fully inherits the architecture of the Manacá-1B
base model (Table 1 ): a 24-layer Llama-style decoder-only
transformer, model dimension 2048, 8192 SwiGLU FFN, 32 attention heads with 8
key-value groups (GQA), RoPE, RMSNorm, and learned biases in all linear
layers. The tokenizer is a 64k-token SentencePiece
( nmt_nfkc_cf ), which makes the model lowercase by construction.
Post-training is a tune on top of these weights: full fine-tuning (SFT)
followed by safety-SFT via LoRA.

blocks.en:
SFT uses full fine-tuning on the Manacá-1B base, 291,223 training examples
and 3,000 validation examples (split before training, never merged), for 3
epochs with load_best_model_at_end (selects the checkpoint with
the lowest eval_loss , not the last one). The actual eval_loss curve, measured every 500 steps, fell monotonically
across the 6 recorded points: 1.3474 → \to 1.2661 → \to 1.2359 → \to 1.2119 → \to 1.2027 → \to 1.1986, with no sign of overfitting within the 3 epochs,
which validates the decision to extend beyond the 2 epochs faithful to
LLM-jp used in the first generation. train/loss follows the same
trend (from 3.14 at step 10 to the 1.05–1.15 range at the end), with no
train × \times eval divergence. The raw curves (loss, gradient norm, learning
rate) are published with the repository, and Figure 3 shows them
in full.

During SFT, we tested live (on CPU, over intermediate checkpoints) a

inverse picture of math/code: on tasks that depend on cultural/linguistic
domain knowledge in Portuguese, where Manacá’s SFT corpus was designed to
help, v4 competes with, and sometimes beats, a model with far more
pre-training compute, but inherited from a predominantly
English/Chinese-speaking ecosystem. Third, on safety ( n = 4 n{=}4 items per model in this specific MT-Bench category, on the same set of
sensitive prompts used in the mandatory core) v4 ( 9.00 9.00 ) and

( 1.00 1.00 – 4.75 4.75 ), with Tucano2-qwen nominally ahead of v4 on this
judged response-quality metric. This does not contradict this
section’s main result: held-out safety ( N = 218 N{=}218 ) measures refusal
rate , a binary variable with a narrow Wilson CI, while this MT-Bench
category measures the judge’s subjective quality of the refusal ,
with only 4 items and therefore no statistical power to separate 9.00 9.00 from 9.75 9.75 . It is also worth noting that this is exactly the
judge/category pair, safety prompts scored by LLM-as-a-Judge, where
Section 4.5 documents a categorical-score-refusal failure mode
in the judge itself; the judge’s two refusals per model (the same rate
across all six) already reduce this category’s effective n n from 6 to 4,
which reinforces that this specific number should be read with more caution

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Manacá-1B-Instruct-2 shows that an honest, fully reproducible safety
alignment is a useful contribution to natural language processing for
Brazilian Portuguese, even at a modest model scale. Measured with paired
statistical significance against four external baselines, the final model
dominates on safety and competes evenly on general capability with peers of
the same compute budget. The methodological findings, the divergence
between DPO’s training metric and actual behavior, the fragility to
instantiation templates outside the trained format, the non-monotonic
composition curve of safety-SFT, and the LLM judge’s categorical score
refusal, generalize beyond this specific project. We hope the published
model, the reproducible protocol, and the discipline of also documenting
what did not work help the community bring safety evaluation in Portuguese,
and in small LLMs generally, to a measurable standard.

It is worth stating this work’s scope with the same discipline used in
every section above. Safety is not 100%: despite being statistically
robust (97.2%, N = 218 N{=}218 ), the true measured harmful-compliance rate is
0.46% (1/218), ambiguously phrased requests can still get through.
Over-refusal persists on a small fraction of benign requests (9.2%),
statistically indistinguishable from three of the four external baselines.
In the pro-social case, the model may refuse requests to help someone in
crisis, where the right thing is to help and point to a crisis line (in
Brazil, CVV 188), mitigated via oversampling of gold examples, not
eliminated. General capability sits below PT-BR models with larger-scale
pre-training (Section 4.7 ), a compute effect, not a
methodology one. The multiple-choice exams (ENEM/OAB/BLUEX) sit at chance
level, a known limit of broad factual knowledge in natively PT-BR ∼ \sim 1B
models. The composition scan remains at N = 16 N{=}16 /34 per point and a single
round per point, treat the knee point as exploratory, not definitive, until
the sample is expanded. Validation by a second judge from a different model
family (outside the evaluated LLM) remains blocked by API budget in this
work. Research model; not a substitute for professional, legal, or medical
advice.

blocks.en:
The natural next steps are to expand, not redesign. The composition scan
(Section 4.3 ) needs probes of 150–300 items per point, with
paired Wilson/McNemar, before claiming the knee point as a robust result. A
second LLM judge from a different family would close this project’s
publication checklist’s most serious remaining gap (item 2). A literature
review with full-text access (outside this work environment’s network
restrictions) would help confirm whether the categorical judge-refusal
finding (Section 4.5 ) is indeed novel before formally claiming
so. Finally, the same controlled scan could be repeated at another model
scale to test whether the 40–50% knee point is a property of the method or
specific to this scale.
